scripts.build: bun run build:ts && bun run build:rust && bun run build:swift
scripts.build:rust: cargo test --workspace --no-run && cargo build -p photoctl-image && node scripts/package-native.mjs
scripts.build:swift: if [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] && [ -f helpers/mac/Package.swift ]; then swift build --package-path helpers/mac; else echo 'Swift build skipped (non-macOS)'; fi
scripts.test: bun run test:ts && bun run test:rust && bun run test:functional && bun run test:macos
scripts.test:ts: bun run build:rust && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:macos: if [ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ]; then bun run build:swift && vitest run --config vitest.macos.config.ts; else echo 'macOS tests skipped (non-macOS)'; fi
scripts.verify: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-versions.mjs && git add apps/*/package.json packages/*/package.json
